metadata.description: The Purely Personal AI C-Suite plugin · 5 engines (Marketing, Sales, Operations, Cash, Leadership) + 38 frameworks + BUSINESS-BRAIN.md as the context layer

plugins.name: purely-personal
plugins.description: An AI C-Suite for solopreneurs. 8 slash commands wired to BUSINESS-BRAIN.md and 38 operator-grade frameworks. Marketing, Sales, Operations, Cash, and Leadership engines that read your business context and ship real work in minutes.

plugins.name: ai-employee-bootcamp
plugins.description: Your complete AI employee team. One brain. Five executives. 26 skills across marketing, sales, operations, finance, content, outreach, and skill customisation, running on a schedule while you sleep. Every skill reads BUSINESS-BRAIN.md first, then your foundation documents from your Business Brain folder or GitHub repo. Build My Business Brain turns your foundation documents into one filled BUSINESS-BRAIN.md. CMO drafts today's post in your voice. CRO builds 10 qualified prospects with personalised DM sequences powered by the Sell-by-Chat playbook. COO briefs your morning. CFO reports your revenue. LinkedIn Carousel Builder and Cheatsheet Builder turn any idea into designed, save-worthy LinkedIn assets. Viral Hook Generator spins up 24 scroll-stopping hooks on demand. Matchmaker audits your skills against your documents. Tailor fits every skill to your exact ICP, voice, and offer. Every output follows the shared visual standards: branded, animated HTML in your colors. by Daniel Paul, Purely Personal.

plugins.name: email-writer
plugins.description: Write emails that get clients, in your own voice, from your Second Brain. Five email recipes (client win, story, 9-word email, how-to, event invite), subject lines in 12 patterns or in the style of ones you love, a strict 1 to 10 rater that rewrites until it's a 10, a month of emails planned from your weekly promise, and a Gmail-style inbox preview with copy buttons for GoHighLevel, Mailchimp and ActiveCampaign. Never sends on its own. by Daniel Paul, Purely Personal.
